dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, linear narrowing of the 2D contour from the mid-body toward the posterior extremity.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Off-white to light-grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker-grey pixel clusters localized along the posterior dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transition between the primary light tone and the darker posterior region.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single, high-contrast, circular dark-pixel feature in the anterior dorsal region.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear, shadow-casting longitudinal indentation along the posterior central dorsal axis.
